master.title: Channel Orange
master.notes:
Official vinyl reissues starting in July 2025 were released by the artist with different audio content depending on the metalwork used. Metalwork with:
- BLDD 000-A includes an audio sample from Street Fighter. BLNDD 0000-A omits this audio.
- BLDD 000-B has not had any audio differences from BLNDD 0000-B confirmed
- BLDD 000-C includes track C12 'White (feat. John Mayer)'. BLNDD 0000-C omits this song.
- BLDD 000-D includes track D14's intro "and the peaches..." BLNDD 0000-D omits this intro.

Releases include the standard metalwork, with catalog number BLNDD 0000, except where noted:
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/34511269-Frank-Ocean-Channel-Orange]BLNDD 0000[/url]
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/34870232-Frank-Ocean-Channel-Orange]BLDD 000-D[/url]
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/36080959-Frank-Ocean-Channel-Orange]BLDD 000-C[/url]
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/36243751-Frank-Ocean-Channel-Orange]BLDD 000-A, BLDD 000-C[/url]
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/37529103-Frank-Ocean-Channel-Orange]BLDD 000-B[/url]
